newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania issues 534.3 bln lei rollover treasury-bills.
newsitem.headline: Romania issues 534.3 bln lei rollover treasury-bills.

text.p: Romania's Finance Ministry said it would launch this week 534.3 billion lei worth of 105-day treasury bills designed to refinance part of the budget deficits of the past three years.

It said T-bills would be offered with a coupon giving an annual yield equaling the three-month Bucharest Interbank Bid Rate (BUBID) set five days ahead of the public subscription scheduled for September 26.
On Tuesday three-month BUBID was 49.98 percent.
The T-bills will be placed by the central bank and can be bought by banks and their corporate clients.
